Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Subsection 99(2)(a) relates to entry of a vehicle for the purpose of inspection of equipment and record sheets.
(ii) Subsection 99(2)(b) relates to entry of premises for the purposes of inspection of documents and vehicles.
(iii) Subsection 99(3) gives a power to detain vehicles.
(iv) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
